desc: The Cypher X model features a solid frame for durability and strength. Top tang barrel selector and safety. Light-weight aluminum mono-block barrel construction and Turkish Walnut Stock & Forearm, featuring a fiber optic sight. Comes with 5 extended color/color-coded choke tubes (SK, IC, M, IM, F), choke box and choke wrench. The Cypher X is offered in five gauges.
